title: [storage][observability] storage.disk_fall says the worse of the week's fit and the last day's fall, with its basis (4/141's FAIL: the disk fell 77 GB in a day while the fit said gaining)
prompt:
Spawn, objective 222 [storage][observability] (the lead's YES of 2026-11-18 15:55, sync/obj-222/scope.md: id 222, the basis on the Core lines diagnostic too, 36 h as the staleness bound; author rev-i; readers rev-e first, rev-h second; the follow-up to 4/141's FAIL, sync/verify/4-141-rev-i.md): storage.disk_fall says the worse of the week's fit and the last day's fall, with its basis.

Base: live main b701a85f.

The problem: on 2026-11-18 df's free disk fell 77 GB in 24 h (179.0 GB at 14:54:59 +08, 101.9 GB at 14:55:50 the next day), while storage.disk_fall read -4.7 GB a day ("gaining"). core_lines/disk.rs fits a least-squares line through the 7 UTC days' last samples and now. This week's free disk was a sawtooth (129.1, 61.6, 163.7, 158.6, 171.4, 145.0 GB, then 101.9 now): sweeps lifted the line through a day that lost 77 GB. A robust line does not help: Theil-Sen over the same points reads +3.2 GB a day, because the week did gain overall.

Read first: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/disk.rs (readings, fall, days_left, grew_most, with_disk); crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/storage.rs (the storage.disk_fall figure); crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (Figure, figure_json).

What changes:
(1) day_fall(samples, free_now, now_ms): the free disk lost from the latest of the window's samples carrying a number for storage.free_bytes at or before now less 24 h, if it is at or after now less 36 h, to the free disk now, over the days between them, rounded, in bytes a day; below zero when the disk gained. None without such a sample or a free disk now. It reads the same samples with_disk already gets for the fit: no store read of its own.
(2) worse(fit, day): the larger of the two with its basis, "fit" or "day"; a tie is the fit's; either alone when the other is none; none when both are.
(3) with_disk: disk_fall_bytes_per_day is worse's value and disk_fall_basis its basis (null with no value). days_left and days_left_measuring_since_ms follow the fall said. grew_most stays on the fit's fall: health.storage's growth_parts grow over the same week, and a day's fall less a week's growth would call a store's sudden day unattributed (R2, rev-e's R1 F1).
(4) The storage.disk_fall figure says its basis: Figure gains `basis` (said as `basis` in the answer when set); no other figure sets it.
(5) disk.rs's module doc says why: a disk swept by hand rises and falls in steps.

What stays as it is: the readings and the fit; storage.free_bytes and disk_low (objective 204); the ranges file; every other figure; the trend of storage.disk_fall (each day's last value); no schema, no deploy.

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/disk.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/storage.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (with their unit tests); owner: rsi/scenarios/222.sh, rsi/backlog/222.json.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/222.sh, black box on its own database, through GET /api/core-lines of a real spawn serve, with hourly host.core_lines samples planted as a loop records them, their free disk set against the free disk F the serve reads:
- (1) a week rising 10 GB a day up to F + 80 GB a day ago, then falling through the last day to F: disk_fall within 2 GB of 80 GB a day, basis "day"; storage.grew_most (no store measured: unattributed) the week's fit, under 40 GB a day, never the day's 80;
- (1b) the same with no sample between 23 h and 29 h ago (the latest a day old 30 h old, F + 77.5 GB): within 2 GB of 62 GB a day, basis "day" (the day's fall is scaled by the days between);
- (2) a week falling 10 GB a day down to F - 10 GB a day ago, then rising to F: the fit's (above 0), basis "fit";
- (3) the same week as (1) with no sample in the last 37 h (the newest day-old sample 37 h old, which taken would say about 48 GB a day): the fit's, basis "fit";
- (4) no sample: no value, no basis;
- (5) two samples only, F + 25 GB 24 h + 60 s ago and F + 10 GB 60 s before today's UTC midnight (both yesterday's): no fit (the readings span under a day); the day's, within 2 GB of 25 GB a day, basis "day".
On live main b701a85f, 222.sh exits 1.

Tests (unit, disk.rs): the day's fall from the latest sample a day old, not the oldest; exactly 36 h taken, a millisecond older not; samples under a day old not taken; none without a sample or a free disk now; a day that gained below zero; worse's table (larger, tie, both gaining, either alone, none); the replay of 2026-11-18 (the week's trend values, df's two readings: fit -4,739,443,506, day 77,104,383,700, the figure the day's with 1 day left; the same week with a day that gained 10 GB: the fit's); a day's fall with no fit; the store that grew most judged over the week (the fit's fall), not the day's (a flat week, then 20 GiB in the archive in the last day). storage.rs: the basis on the disk_fall diagnostic and on no other; none when the fall has none. No test is renamed or dropped.

Verified by: after landing, on live, storage.disk_fall's basis and value against df over the last day (the lead reads /api/core-lines and df at the same minute).
